name: Jeeter | Blue ZKZ | 2G Liquid Diamond XL All-In-One Vape
description: Blue ZKZ is an indica cross of Blue Diamond and Zkittlez. This vibrant flower features a bold terpene profile of tart citrus, sweet earth, and wildflowers. Known for its rich aroma and flavor, Blue ZKZ is a laid-back strain that sets the tone for a slow evening.
